verdict.rationale: Lago's API reference documents that every endpoint has a generated command, it publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for full programmatic access, and core UI actions (plans, subscriptions, invoices, usage metering, webhooks) are all documented as API-driven, with usage-metering docs explicitly noting both API and no-code UI paths update the same underlying data. This is corroborated by a live OpenAPI probe and API-first framing throughout the docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that literally 100% of UI-only settings (e.g., some admin/org configuration screens) have API parity, and no explicit statement claiming full UI/API feature parity.
